ownership.quote: Today, we are proud to announce that Lambda has raised a $320 million Series C led by US Innovative Technology Fund (USIT) with participation from new investors B Capital, SK Telecom, T. Rowe Price Associates, Inc...

stage.quote: AI data center provider Lambda announced Tuesday it raised $1.5 billion in a round led by TWG Global... Prior to this, Lambda raised a $480 million Series D in February, with an estimated valuation of $2.5 billion, according to PitchBook.
stage.note: Last priced round (Nov 2025, $1.5B led by TWG Global) is a post-Series-D growth round not publicly labeled with a letter; mapped to series-d+. A further $3B pre-IPO raise at a $12B+ valuation was in talks as of Aug 2026 but terms were not finalized/reported closed as of the check date.

total_funding_usd.basis: Sum of disclosed equity rounds: $15M Series A (2021) + $44M Series B (2023) + $320M Series C (Feb 2024) + $480M Series D (Feb 2025) + $1.5B growth round (Nov 2025); close to Sacra's aggregate of $2.3B funding as of 2025-11-19.

last_round.quote: AI data center provider Lambda announced Tuesday it raised $1.5 billion in a round led by TWG Global, a relatively new $40 billion investment firm formed by billionaires Thomas Tull... and Mark Walter.

revenue.quote: As of 2025, Lambda AI generated an estimated $303.3M in annual revenue.

note: Founded 2012 by twin brothers Stephen and Michael Balaban, originally an AI/photo-editing company that pivoted to GPU hardware and cloud (Lambda GPU Cloud launched 2018). In May 2026 Lambda brought in Michel Combes (ex-Sprint/SoftBank International CEO) as CEO, with co-founder Stephen Balaban moving to CTO after 14 years running the company. As of Aug 2026 Lambda was reportedly in talks to raise up to $3B pre-IPO at a $12B+ valuation ahead of a planned 2027 listing (Bloomberg via TheNextWeb), alongside separate GPU-backed debt financings (e.g. a $500M facility in 2024 and $917M in chip-backed borrowing) that are not counted as equity funding here.
